rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Connects to the Defense.com XDR platform to provide comprehensive threat intelligence access through 16 specialized tools. Supports querying open threats, analyzing risk scores, tracking remediation assignments, and monitoring detection events. Includes workload analysis for team management, keyword-based threat search, and interactive security training sessions with quizzes and progress tracking. Features 200+ source type aliases for intuitive filtering across categories like penetration tests, Microsoft 365, vulnerability scans, and phishing campaigns.
